title: What If You Stood on Jupiter's Volcano Moon Io?

scenes.text: What if you stood on Io? The ground under you is never still.
Io is about the size of our Moon, and it's the most volcanically active world in the solar system.
Jupiter and its other moons keep squeezing and stretching Io, and that friction melts its insides.
The surface is dotted with lava lakes. In one mapped region, about three percent is a molten lake.
Plumes of volcanic gas would shoot up above you, and Jupiter would hang huge in the sky.
No air, no shelter, and constant radiation. Io is beautiful from far away, and deadly up close.

description:
